symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1617: DESCRIBE MICROFLOW printed a Show page action whose 'Number of pages to close' is 1 (Microflows$ShowFormAction.NumberOfPagesToClose "1") exactly like one that closes none, and no statement could write it: `show page M.P (NumberOfPagesToClose: 1)` passed check and exec and stored ""
cause: Three hops each lacked it: the reader never read NumberOfPagesToClose, the writer hard-coded SetNumberOfPagesToClose(""), and the show page `with` list read title/location/modal and silently ignored any other key. The reporter's paren spelling is the deprecated `Param: value` ARGUMENT form, so it wrote a page parameter mapping to a parameter the page does not have (CE1613 in mxbuild) while `check --references` said 'All references valid' — the flow calls had that check (#953), show page did not
insight: A setting the reporter tried as `(Key: value)` on a call site is not a dropped property but a dangling ARGUMENT — check the argument-name validation before adding a property, because that is what told the user nothing. The value is a MicroflowExpression per the Model SDK (introduced 8.11, no version gate), and mxbuild 11.12.5 is the arbiter of which values pass: 0, -1, 2 and `$Count + 1` build clean, 1.5 and a Boolean are CE0117, `order` for parameter `Order` is CE1613 (case-sensitive) — so the visitor refuses only non-integer literals, ungated like `close page 1.5` since the key never worked. `with location`/`modal` were read into PageSettings that no writer emits (location deleted in 8.0), now MDL-V1-PROP. Prove the round trip with drop + exec of the description and a raw grep of the unit: an 'Unchanged' report is the writer comparing two read-backs that both lack the field, which is why the reporter saw no data loss
